parameters_tenant_uq.name: parameters_tenant_uq
parameters_tenant_uq.where: "parameters"."tenant_id" is not null and "parameters"."outlet_id" is null

trip_payments_amounts_chk.name: trip_payments_amounts_chk
trip_payments_amounts_chk.value: ("trip_payments"."reversal_of_id" is null and "trip_payments"."received_amount" >= 0 and "trip_payments"."underpayment_amount" >= 0 and ("trip_payments"."method" <> 'cash' or "trip_payments"."received_amount" + "trip_payments"."underpayment_amount" = "trip_payments"."expected_amount")) or ("trip_payments"."reversal_of_id" is not null and "trip_payments"."received_amount" <= 0 and "trip_payments"."underpayment_amount" <= 0 and "trip_payments"."expected_amount" <= 0)

office_cash_movements_source_uq.name: office_cash_movements_source_uq
office_cash_movements_source_uq.where: "office_cash_movements"."reversal_of_id" is null and "office_cash_movements"."source_object_id" is not null

consumable_receipts_transfer_uq.name: consumable_receipts_transfer_uq
consumable_receipts_transfer_uq.where: "consumable_receipts"."internal_transfer_id" is not null and "consumable_receipts"."reversal_of_id" is null and "consumable_receipts"."reversed_at" is null

outlet_water_ledger_source_uq.name: outlet_water_ledger_source_uq
outlet_water_ledger_source_uq.where: "outlet_water_ledger"."reversal_of_id" is null and "outlet_water_ledger"."source_object_id" is not null

pos_sales_reversal_chk.name: pos_sales_reversal_chk
pos_sales_reversal_chk.value: ("pos_sales"."is_reversal" = false and "pos_sales"."reversal_of_id" is null and "pos_sales"."total" >= 0) or ("pos_sales"."is_reversal" = true and "pos_sales"."reversal_of_id" is not null and "pos_sales"."total" <= 0)

water_supply_receipts_trip_uq.name: water_supply_receipts_trip_uq
water_supply_receipts_trip_uq.where: "water_supply_receipts"."trip_id" is not null and "water_supply_receipts"."reversal_of_id" is null and "water_supply_receipts"."reversed_at" is null

internal_transfers_number_chk.name: internal_transfers_number_chk
internal_transfers_number_chk.value: ("internal_transfers"."number" is not null or "internal_transfers"."local_number" is not null) and ("internal_transfers"."device_id" is null or ("internal_transfers"."local_number" is not null and "internal_transfers"."device_seq" is not null))

purchase_receipts_supplier_note_uq.name: purchase_receipts_supplier_note_uq
purchase_receipts_supplier_note_uq.where: "purchase_receipts"."supplier_note_number" is not null and "purchase_receipts"."reversal_of_id" is null and "purchase_receipts"."status" <> 'reversed'

purchase_receipts_number_chk.name: purchase_receipts_number_chk
purchase_receipts_number_chk.value: ("purchase_receipts"."number" is not null or "purchase_receipts"."local_number" is not null) and ("purchase_receipts"."device_id" is null or ("purchase_receipts"."local_number" is not null and "purchase_receipts"."device_seq" is not null))

truck_fills_trip_live_uq.name: truck_fills_trip_live_uq
truck_fills_trip_live_uq.where: "truck_fills"."trip_id" is not null and "truck_fills"."reversal_of_id" is null and "truck_fills"."reversed_at" is null

journals_auto_event_uq.name: journals_auto_event_uq
journals_auto_event_uq.where: "journals"."kind" = 'auto' and "journals"."source_event_id" is not null and "journals"."reversal_of_id" is null
